```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) {
  library(neuro2)
}

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Standard column order
standard_col_order <- c(
  "scale",
  "raw_score",
  "score",
  "ci_95",
  "percentile",
  "range",
  "test",
  "test_name",
  "domain",
  "subdomain",
  "narrow",
  "pass",
  "verbal",
  "timed",
  "test_type",
  "score_type",
  "absort",
  "description",
  "result"
)

# WRAT-5 scale definitions from lookup table
wrat5_scale_info <- list(
  "Math Computation" = list(
    subdomain = "Math",
    narrow = "Math Achievement",
    pass = "Simultaneous",
    verbal = "Nonverbal",
    timed = "Untimed",
    absort = "wrat5_01",
    description = "Paper-and-pencil math calculation skills, ranging from basic operations with integers to geometry, algebra, and calculus problems"
  ),
  "Spelling" = list(
    subdomain = "Writing",
    narrow = "Spelling Ability",
    pass = "Sequential",
    verbal = "Nonverbal",
    timed = "Untimed",
    absort = "wrat5_02",
    description = "Written spelling of words from dictations"
  ),
  "Word Reading" = list(
    subdomain = "Premorbid Ability",
    narrow = "Word Reading",
    pass = "Knowledge",
    verbal = "Verbal",
    timed = "Untimed",
    absort = "wrat5_03",
    description = "An estimate of premorbid verbal ability level"
  ),
  "Sentence Comprehension" = list(
    subdomain = "Reading",
    narrow = "Reading Comprehension",
    pass = "Knowledge",
    verbal = "Verbal",
    timed = "Untimed",
    absort = "wrat5_04",
    description = "An estimate of reading comprehension via sentences."
  ),
  "Reading Composite" = list(
    subdomain = "Reading",
    narrow = "Reading Ability",
    pass = "Sequential",
    verbal = "Verbal",
    timed = "Untimed",
    absort = "wrat5_05",
    description = "Composite score of decoding and comprehension that balances word-level and text-level reading skills"
  )
)

# Load lookup table for additional data
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(test == "wrat5")
} else {
  lookup_table <- NULL
}
```

## WRAT-5 Wide Range Achievement Test

Upload a WRAT-5 PDF report to extract the score table.

**Test Info:** Domain = Academic Skills (Word Reading = General Cognitive Ability) | Score Type = Standard Score | Test Type = npsych_test

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload WRAT-5 PDF", accept = ".pdf")
numericInput("pages", "Page to Scan", value = 2, min = 1, max = 20)
selectInput(
  "method",
  "Extraction Method",
  choices = c("stream", "lattice"),
  selected = "stream"
)
hr()
uiOutput("table_selector_ui")
hr()
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract Tables", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

verbatimTextOutput("status")
hr()
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")
hr()
h4("Processed Data")
DTOutput("results_table")
hr()
tags$details(
  tags$summary("Raw Extraction (Debug)"),
  DTOutput("raw_table")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

raw_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)
  withProgress(message = "Extracting...", {
    tryCatch(
      {
        tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          file = input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$pages,
          method = input$method,
          output = "matrix"
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
        NULL
      }
    )
  })
})

output$table_selector_ui <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n <- length(raw_tables())
  if (n > 1) {
    selectInput(
      "table_idx",
      paste("Table (", n, "found)"),
      choices = seq_len(n),
      selected = 1
    )
  }
})

selected_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$table_idx)) as.integer(input$table_idx) else 1
})

candidate_df <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[selected_idx()]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  df
})

output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_df())
  df <- candidate_df()
  cols <- colnames(df)

  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    setNames(
      cols,
      sapply(cols, function(c) {
        preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 2), collapse = ", ")
        paste0(c, " (", substr(preview, 1, 25), ")")
      })
    )
  }

  choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
  none <- c("None" = "None")

  wellPanel(
    h5("Column Mapping"),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_scale",
          "Scale:",
          choices = choices,
          selected = cols[1]
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_raw",
          "Raw Score:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None"
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_score",
          "Standard Score:",
          choices = choices,
          selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else cols[1]
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_ci",
          "95% CI:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = "None"
        )
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_percentile",
          "Percentile:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = "None"
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_range",
          "Category:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = "None"
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_grade",
          "Grade Equiv:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = "None"
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_gsv",
          "GSV:",
          choices = c(none, choices),
          selected = "None"
        )
      )
    )
  )
})

processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_df(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)

  df <- candidate_df()

  result <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_numeric(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Add optional columns
  if (!is.null(input$col_raw) && input$col_raw != "None") {
    result$raw_score <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_raw]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_ci) && input$col_ci != "None") {
    result$ci_95 <- gsub("–|—", "-", trimws(df[[input$col_ci]]))
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_percentile) && input$col_percentile != "None") {
    result$percentile <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_percentile]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_range) && input$col_range != "None") {
    result$range <- trimws(df[[input$col_range]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_grade) && input$col_grade != "None") {
    result$grade_equiv <- trimws(df[[input$col_grade]])
  }
  if (!is.null(input$col_gsv) && input$col_gsv != "None") {
    result$gsv <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_gsv]])
  }

  # Filter valid rows
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score))

  # Add test metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = "wrat5",
      test_name = "WRAT-5",
      test_type = "npsych_test",
      score_type = "standard_score"
    )

  # Add scale-specific info from lookup (domain depends on scale)
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Word Reading is under General Cognitive Ability, others under Academic Skills
      domain = ifelse(
        scale == "Word Reading",
        "General Cognitive Ability",
        "Academic Skills"
      ),
      subdomain = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$subdomain
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      narrow = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$narrow
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      pass = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$pass
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      verbal = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$verbal
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      timed = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$timed
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      absort = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$absort
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      description = if (scale %in% names(wrat5_scale_info)) {
        wrat5_scale_info[[scale]]$description
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # Add result column
  result$result <- NA_character_

  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (
    neuro2_available &&
      exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))
  ) {
    result <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(
      result,
      test_type = "npsych_test"
    )
  }

  # Reorder columns
  result |> dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
})

output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(raw_tables())) {
    return("Click 'Extract Tables' after uploading PDF")
  }
  paste0(
    "✓ ",
    length(raw_tables()),
    " table(s) | ",
    nrow(processed_data()),
    " records"
  )
})

output$raw_table <- renderDT({
  req(candidate_df())
  datatable(candidate_df(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5))
})

output$results_table <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(processed_data(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("wrat5_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```
